Fairies are entities which provide passive boosts to potion making. Their range of effects vary from decreasing quest wait time, increasing enhancement chance, changing material probabilities, and more.

Sources[]

Fairies are obtained by requesting the travelers to complete certain requests. Occasionally, they will return with fairies.

Fairies are leveled up by completing the same request a type of fairy is a reward from and receiving them again. Some fairies have a higher percent chance of being given as a quest reward than others, making some fairies easier/harder to level up than others. Upon leveling up a fairy, the effect they give upon being summoned is increased.

The current max level fairies can achieve is 10.
